text: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，积极推进煤炭法修订，完善煤炭行业标准（MT）体系。强化 煤炭矿区总体规划管理，严格落实矿区总体规划确定的开发方案， 提高资源集约高效开发水平。加强产能“一本账”管理，适时调整 完善产能置换政策，强化产能登记公告管理，促进建设生产平稳有 序。强化煤矿关闭退出计划管理，引导企业平稳转型，稳妥做好人 员安置、债务处置、生态修复等工作。健全煤炭产供储销统计体系， 强化能源、安监、税务等部门信息共享和协同监管，加强煤炭生产 监督管理，严厉打击煤矿超产行为，规范煤炭市场秩序。
text_en: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development,' which calls for actively advancing the revision of the Coal Law and improving the coal industry standard (MT) system. It strengthens overall planning management of coal mining areas, strictly implements development plans determined by mining area master plans, and improves intensive and efficient resource development. It also strengthens 'one ledger' capacity management, timely adjusts and improves capacity replacement policies, strengthens capacity registration announcement management, and promotes smooth and orderly construction and production. The plan strengthens management of coal mine closure and exit plans, guides enterprises in smooth transition, and properly handles personnel placement, debt disposal, and ecological restoration. It also improves the coal production-supply-storage-sales statistical system, strengthens information sharing and coordinated supervision among energy, safety supervision, and tax departments, intensifies coal production supervision, severely cracks down on mine overproduction, and regulates coal market order.
